description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four variants of the DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) model, measured by MRR@10 (Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10), as a function of the number of queries used during inference (labeled as “S” on the x-axis). The x-axis ranges from approximately 2 to 8, with tick marks at integer intervals, and is labeled “# of queries used during inference (S)”. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10”, spans from 33.5 to 36.0, with major tick marks at 0.5 intervals. Four distinct lines represent different DPR configurations: a solid black line for “DPR w/o query”, a red line with circular markers for “DPR w/ corpus expansion”, a green line with triangular markers for “DPR w/ document expansion”, and a blue line with star markers for “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion”. The red line starts at approximately MRR@10 = 35.1 at S=2 and steadily increases to about 36.0 at S=8. The green line begins near 34.8 at S=2 and rises gradually to approximately 35.8 at S=8. The blue line starts around 34.9 at S=2, dips slightly to 34.8 at S=3, then rises to about 35.7 at S=8. The black line remains constant across all S values, fixed at approximately MRR@10 = 34.5. All lines show either steady improvement or stability as S increases, with the red line consistently outperforming the others across the range.
